name: Cycle Detection (DFS)
description: Detects if a directed graph contains a cycle using DFS with a recursion stack. A back edge (edge to an ancestor in DFS tree) indicates a cycle.
aim: Detect cycles in a directed graph by running DFS and checking if any edge leads to a node already in the current DFS path (recursion stack).
howItWorks: Run DFS from each unvisited vertex
When visiting a vertex, add to recursion stack
If we reach a vertex already in stack: CYCLE detected
When backtracking, remove vertex from stack

complexity.spaceDescription: Visited array + recursion stack of size V

realWorld: Circular dependency detection in build tools
whenToUse: Topological sort validation (cycle ⟹ no valid ordering)
alternatives: Kahn's topological sort — if result has fewer than V nodes, cycle exists
